double_data_mode.title: DMA double data mode
double_data_mode.description: DMA double data mode allow the application to efficiently use the bus bandwidth. When the DMA controller is used in normal mode, only 12-bit (or 8-bit) data are transferred by a DMA request. As the AHB width is 32 bits, two 12-bit data may be transferred simultaneously. In DMA double data mode, a DAC DMA request is generated every two external triggers.

actions.message: DMA double data mode is only available when DMA is enabled for the channel.

enable.description: The DAC core converts data and then holds the converted voltage on a capacitor. When not converting, the DAC cores and buffer are completely turned off, therefore reducing the overall power consumption.

sample_cycles.title: Sample time
sample_cycles.description: Sample phase: the sample/hold element is charged to the desired voltage. The charging time depends on capacitor value (internal or external, selected by the user).

hold_cycles.title: Hold time
hold_cycles.description: Hold phase: the DAC output channel is tri-stated, the DAC core and the buffer are turned off.

refresh_cycles.title: Refresh time
refresh_cycles.description: Refresh phase: the DAC output buffer is turned on to maintain the voltage on the capacitor above a certain level to avoid significant drop.
